**No.** Krishna Kale can receive hall tickets for the courses where his attendance meets the 75 % minimum, but not for **CS102**, whose attendance is only 73.5 % [SQL].

**Why**

| Course | Attendance % | Exam fee status |
|--------|--------------|-----------------|
| CS101 | 79.6 % | paid ₹3,500 [SQL] |
| CS102 | 73.5 % | paid ₹3,500 [SQL] |
| CS103 | 85.6 % | paid ₹3,500 [SQL] |
| CS104 | 77.2 % | paid ₹3,500 [SQL] |
| CS105 | 77.8 % | paid ₹3,500 [SQL] |

* The examination fee for the term is fully paid for every course [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5 Hall tickets].
* The minimum‑attendance rule requires **≥ 75 % in each registered course** [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance].
* Attendance in CS102 (73.5 %) falls short of this threshold, so the hall ticket for that course cannot be issued.  
* No detention applies (attendance ≥ 65 % in all courses) [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4 Detention].

**Result:** Hall tickets can be issued for CS101, CS103, CS104, and CS105, but not for CS102 unless an approved condonation is obtained (not shown in the evidence).
sql: SELECT f.component, f.amount_due, f.amount_paid, f.status AS fee_status, c.course_code, e.status AS enrollment_status, e.attendance_pct FROM students AS s LEFT JOIN fee_ledger AS f ON s.student_id = f.student_id LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id LEFT JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2026CS003' LIMIT 200
